scenes.caption: Fatima eats.
scenes.say: Fatima bites an apple. Her sharp front teeth cut it.

scenes.caption: Chew and swallow.
scenes.say: Her flat back teeth grind the food. Saliva makes it soft to swallow.

scenes.caption: The stomach.
scenes.say: The food slides down the oesophagus. The stomach churns it with acid.

scenes.caption: Nutrients go in.
scenes.say: In the small intestine, nutrients pass into the blood. Waste goes on.

scenes.caption: Time to jump.
scenes.say: Fatima jumps rope. Her muscles pull her bones, and they work in pairs.

scenes.caption: A fast heart.
scenes.say: Her heart beats faster. It pumps more oxygen to her working muscles.

scenes.caption: Clean teeth.
scenes.say: At night she brushes her teeth. That stops sugar turning into acid.

scenes.caption: A healthy body.
scenes.say: Bones, muscles, teeth and a heart all work together. Well done, Fatima!
